title: Table 5-12: UPS menu icon and UPS data window
markdown:
Table 5-12: UPS menu icon and UPS data window

| Menu Icon   | Menu Name         | Menu Item                      | Explanation                                                                    |
|-------------|-------------------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|             | Input parameter   | Input voltage (V)              | Input voltage                                                                  |
|             | Input parameter   | Input current (A)              | Input current                                                                  |
|             | Input parameter   | Input frequency (Hz)           | Input frequency                                                                |
|             | Bypass parameter  | Bypass voltage (V)             | Bypass voltage                                                                 |
|             | Bypass parameter  | Bypass frequency (Hz)          | Bypass frequency                                                               |
|             | Output parameter  | Output voltage (V)             | Output voltage                                                                 |
|             | Output parameter  | Output current (A)             | Output current                                                                 |
|             | Output parameter  | Output frequency (Hz)          | Output frequency                                                               |
|             | Output parameter  | Power factor                   | Power factor                                                                   |
|             | Load parameter    | Active power (kW)              | Pout: active power                                                             |
|             | Load parameter    | Apparent power (kVA)           | Sout: apparent power                                                           |
|             | Load parameter    | Load rate (%)                  | Load (UPS rated load percentage)                                               |
|             | Battery parameter | Battery voltage (V)            | Battery voltage                                                                |
|             | Battery parameter | Battery current (A)            | Charging and discharging current of battery                                    |
|             | Battery parameter | Battery temperature ( ℃ )      | Display battery temperature after access to battery temperature detection      |
|             | Battery parameter | Environment temperature ( ℃ )  | Environment temperature                                                        |
|             | Battery parameter | Battery status                 | Equalizing charge, floating charge, battery discharging, battery self-testing  |
|             | Battery parameter | Battery info                   | 100 Ah * 50 pcs * 1 group                                                      |
|             | Battery parameter | Next time of battery self-test | Display next time of battery self-test after related parameters are configured |
|             | Fault record      | Fault record                   | Fault logging                                                                  |
|             | Warning record    | Warning record                 | Warning logging                                                                |
